Hello
I'm Andy — I build medical education for everyone.

I'm a one-person team making study tools around minimum diagnostic criteria, mechanism, and clear reasoning, because medical education is not a luxury for the rich. This page is yours, though — arrange it how you like, and it will be just as you left it when you come back.
